subject: Post-demo privacy guardrails and confirmation to withhold model training
messages:
From: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@ppcsystems.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: james.li@ppcsystems.com
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Demo today — privacy constraints and follow-ups

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier — that was helpful. Per our internal security review I wanted to summarize the controls PPC Systems needs before we proceed to a pilot: 

- Explicit non-consent to use any PPC Systems production or customer data for model training or model improvement. We need a signed confirmation that Redwood will not use our data to improve models, in any training / fine-tuning / public benchmarking workflows.
- PII redaction: any logs or payloads sent to your service must be redacted for direct identifiers (SSNs, full credit card numbers, national IDs) before storage. We will provide a redaction spec; please confirm you can enforce and validate it.
- Retention: audit-log/event retention required is 45 days by policy.
- Residency: all processing and logs for our account must remain in the EU (eu-west-1 region). No cross-region copies.
- Encryption & key control: customer-managed KMS keys are required for stored logs.
- KV cache / persistence: KV caches or any long-term caching used by runtime must be disabled for our tenant or segregated and explicitly excluded from training snapshots.
- Access controls & audit: only named PPC users + Redwoods SREs on a per-incident basis; need RBAC audit trails.

Attachments: I attached our internal privacy requirement PDF and a short redaction checklist (ppc_privacy_requirements.pdf, PII_Sanitization_Guide.pdf).

Next steps we'd like from Redwood: a short attestation we won't be used for model training, a sample privacy addendum we can send to legal, and confirmation you can set retention to 45 days in eu-west-1 with CMK support. James (cc) will be our security contact for technical follow-ups.

Appreciate a short note that you can commit to these items (or call out exceptions).

--
Alicia Moreno
Head of Product
PPC Systems Inc.
A: alicia.moreno@ppcsystems.com
T: +44 20 5555 0123

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@ppcsystems.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, James Li <james.li@ppcsystems.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 08:17:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Demo today — privacy constraints and follow-ups

Alicia — thanks for the clear summary and for sharing the attachments. Confirming receipt and outlining our immediate commitments and clarifying items below so legal and security have a clean checklist.

Commitments we can make now:
- Withhold model training: Redwood will not use any data marked as production customer data from PPC Systems for model training, fine-tuning, or benchmarking. We will formalize this in a privacy addendum and an attestation letter for you to review.
- Residency: We can constrain processing and log storage to eu-west-1 for your tenant.
- Retention: We can set log/audit retention to 45 days as requested.
- KMS: Support for customer-managed keys (BYOK) for stored logs is available — we'll provide the integration checklist.
- Access controls & audit: We will restrict access as requested and provide RBAC logs.

Clarifications / items for legal/security:
- KV cache: Runtime-level in-memory KV caches are ephemeral and not persisted across instances for customer data by default. However, some performance features (prefetching, temporary KV) exist. We will provide a config that disables any persistent caching and ensures no snapshots are taken for your tenant. Need James to confirm this meets your requirement.
- PII redaction: Redwood can accept pre-redacted payloads per your spec. We also offer a managed redaction add-on (we'll provide the technical spec) if you want Redwood to run a redaction pass prior to storage — this requires a separate agreement.

Next steps (what we'll send by EOD):
1) Draft privacy addendum and short attestation letter for your legal team to review.
2) Technical checklist for CMK integration + sample KMS policy.
3) Config doc that shows how to disable KV persistence and set retention to 45 days in eu-west-1.
4) A one-page summary of RBAC/audit capabilities and what logs we can provide for SOC or audit purposes.

If PPC can confirm you want Redwood-managed redaction vs customer-managed redaction, call that out — it affects timelines. Also, please tell us who in your legal team to route the addendum to (name + email).

I'll loop in Monica (solutions engineer) to coordinate the technical artifacts — Monica, can you prepare the config doc and CMK checklist?

Best,

--
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 415-555-0199

(Attachments: ppc_privacy_requirements.pdf, PII_Sanitization_Guide.pdf)

From: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@ppcsystems.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: james.li@ppcsystems.com, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Demo today — privacy constraints and follow-ups

Thanks Sean — that aligns with what we need. A couple of quick notes from security/legal: 

- We want the attestation to explicitly state 'PPC Systems production data will not be used to train, evaluate, or improve Redwood models, either directly or indirectly, and will not be incorporated into model weights or datasets.'
- Please mark the privacy addendum draft with a clause that allows PPC Systems to audit retention configuration on a quarterly basis.
- For redaction: we'll do customer-side redaction per the attached guide for the pilot; evaluate your managed redaction option separately.

Legal point of contact: Sarah Nguyen (sarah.nguyen@ppcsystems.com). Please send the addendum and attestation to Sarah and cc James.

If you can get the docs across this afternoon, we'll ping legal for a rapid review so we can proceed to pilot provisioning next week.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

--
Alicia
Alicia Moreno
Head of Product, PPC Systems Inc.
